description: We are team of creative enthusiasts passionate about storytelling, game development, and visual design. Combining our skills and ideas, we aim to create an engaging experience that brings together an interesting narrative, memorable characters, and educational elements. Our goal is to entertain players while inspiring curiosity about space exploration and NASA's history.
summary:
We created a point-and-click game with visual novel elements. Since we chose the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars", the main focus will be on the story itself and the interactions between the characters.
Alongside the main narrative, we will also explore the stories behind NASA's equipment that was left behind on the Moon and Mars. This will allow us not only to share our own story but also to introduce the audience to interesting facts about NASA's discarded equipment and, hopefully, spark their interest in this topic.
details:
Our game is designed to immerse players in the characters' backgrounds and the overall story. One of its key features is exploring how different people experience and cope with stress, each having their own emotional perspective. Players can also discover how their choices influence the story's ending while learning more about NASA equipment.
During development, we used GOCOD, ChatGPT, and Gemini to speed up the creation of sprites and backgrounds; MiniMuse for character design; Photoshop to correct AI-generated inaccuracies; and StoryPlotter for scriptwriting.
We believe our project stands out through its creative combination of what initially appears to be an ordinary story about a NASA team with real-world facts, psychological horror elements, and mysterious anomalies.
